programme.title: Patterns
programme.desc: Patterns are a design, motif or decoration, formed from regular repeated elements. They can also be naturally-occurring or a random arrangement of shapes, colors which have a regular or decorative effect. Patterns can be stripes, or lines, or alternating colors. The first project has a striped pattern of knots tied with plastic lacing. Next, make felt cookies with a polka dot pattern. Then add a chevron pattern to your art journal. Last, create a folding play mat with landscape patterns of a city scene around a lake.

programme.title: Lines
programme.desc: A line is an infinitely extending one-dimensional figure; one that has length but not width or thickness. In art lines are the basis that give form to a piece of art. They can be straight or curved, thick or thin, and raised or flat. Projects featuring lines: a modern art canvas with paint and masking tape; lines become three dimensional as we make a playhouse for dolls or action figures; continue with your art journal and use brightly colored pens and a special tool to make spirograph line drawings. Finally make an unbreakable stained glass plaque with foil.

This episode's machine tip features Eliane Bergmann showing how to use decorative stitches on quilts.

Host Julie Fei Fan Balzer begins with creating your own stencils to make cookies with a nature theme. Then meet Mary Hettmansperger for a 3D wire sculpture featuring salvaged wire that has been naturally treated. Then Joe Rotella continues his love of bees with a honey bee screen print with incredible detail.

programme.desc: Jaffa, once a major port in the Middle East and the sister city of Tel Aviv, “the most expensive city in the world” per The Economist, has grown into an international tourist center, a coveted destination and last but not least a true real estate gem.

programme.title: Idomeni
programme.desc: Idomeni is both a place suspended in time, and a film shaped by scenes from the parallel lives of adults and children in the camp. The children do not go to school but live in their own world and take care of each other, having little contact with their surroundings. The film catches their bubble and shows: they are tomorrow's Europe. It is a place where you are suspended in time. You cannot move forward and you cannot go back. You are confined. But it is not a prison, it is a refugee camp. Refugee camps are usually located far away from the rest of society and they become like worlds of their own. This is a film about life in the camps. The film does not explore the dramatic events of the journey but the seemingly still and slowed down moments in the camps.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Every soldier, sailor and airmen has to pass one hurdle before coming a member of the military – basic training. This episode examines the physical and psychological tests and training that occur in basic training. The training that takes civilians and molds them into the warriors of the future!

programme.title: War Peace
programme.desc: War/Peace documentary film is re-introducing the radical student activists from the late 60s. Ex-leaders of The Weather Underground movement Bill Ayers and Bernardine Dohrn. For decades the government and press have tried their best to silence them. This film will serve as an historical reminder of what happened the last time a group of young minds planned to take over an unpopular government in Washington.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Combat requires that soldiers be tough, capable of strength and good cardio-vascular endurance. Combat fitness is the specialized training that is given to soldiers to help them survive. We learn why this is important and how this training is even adapted for civilians.

programme.title: Golden Age
programme.desc: Extravaganza and glamour lining up in an existential contest against isolation, slackening limbs and lethargy. With unique access behind the scences, the Palace in Miami is shown as a buzzing and luzurious senior living community, repeatedly voted "American's Number One". The seniors live in a world full of parties and entertainment, but the Palace is also a thrivin business.... Who said that old age has to be boring? Golden Age opens the doors to the Palace, a retirement home of the kind that you have never seen before, in Miami. Gildings, ostentatious chandeliers, marble floors; like a cross between a luxury hotel and an Americanised copy of Versailles, the place is presented by its developers as the most beautiful retirement home in the US. The residents here are pampered by an army of employees devoted to their every whim, in a oermanent party atmosphere. This abundance of luxury, extravagance and entertainment is nonetheless not enough to remove the anxieties of those who live there. Nor can it hide the intention of the investors for whome old age is above all source of income and a growing market. Golden Age takes us on a journey into this baroque universe which tries to suppress the fear of death through dollars, questioning, in a dizzying visual whirlwind, our relationship to old age in its most universal aspect.

programme.title: Slow Fashion
programme.desc: Slow Fashion is a documentary that explores cultural appropriation of indigenous designs in Mexico by an international fashion designer and the way weavers and block printers in Laos and India are working with new sustainable designers, whose principals and practices are based on equality, not hierarchy. A major fashion designer from Paris has been appropriating traditional designs in the community of Tlahuitoltepec in the highlands of Oaxaca, Mexico. In response to this and other instances of global appropriation, Mexico's Ministry of Culture has asked global fashion brands for “a public explanation on what basis it could privatize collective property". Can credit and compensation be given to indigenous communities where the designs come from? Given the vast economic disparity between local communities of origin and the global companies, who are appropriating their designs; it becomes a matter of not only collective property rights, but also human and cultural rights. In Laos, craftmanship and the value of culture is examined by Nanci Takayama, professor/sustainable fashion activist. Working with communities of Laotian weavers, she raises the subject of empowerment of women artisans and weavers and explores alternative socially conscious ways of working with them in collaboration. programme.title: I'm In Love With My Car
programme.desc: A colorful, sparkling history of The Car and us, in it. Hearing, smell, touch, sight, taste, that is to say all of the human biological nature, has apparently changed since we started driving. More than any other object, cars are anthropologically modified human beings, changed our world's perception and our way of engaging with it. With our unconditional love for cars at a turning point, will it survive?

programme.title: Women Behind The Wheel
programme.desc:
Two women. One epic journey. Countless stories that deserve to be heard. Cat and Hannah undertake a road trip across Central Asia on a mission to uncover women's stories in a region miles from their own. But along the journey, they're forced to challenge the assumptions they set out with.

programme.desc: Slow Fashion is a documentary that explores cultural appropriation of indigenous designs in Mexico by an international fashion designer and the way weavers and block printers in Laos and India are working with new sustainable designers, whose principals and practices are based on equality, not hierarchy. A major fashion designer from Paris has been appropriating traditional designs in the community of Tlahuitoltepec in the highlands of Oaxaca, Mexico. In response to this and other instances of global appropriation, Mexico's Ministry of Culture has asked global fashion brands for “a public explanation on what basis it could privatize collective property". Can credit and compensation be given to indigenous communities where the designs come from? Given the vast economic disparity between local communities of origin and the global companies, who are appropriating their designs; it becomes a matter of not only collective property rights, but also human and cultural rights. In Laos, craftmanship and the value of culture is examined by Nanci Takayama, professor/sustainable fashion activist. Working with communities of Laotian weavers, she raises the subject of empowerment of women artisans and weavers and explores alternative socially conscious ways of working with them in collaboration. programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Combat requires that soldiers be tough, capable of strength and good cardio-vascular endurance. Combat fitness is the specialized training that is given to soldiers to help them survive. We learn why this is important and how this training is even adapted for civilians.

programme.title: Golden Age
programme.desc: Extravaganza and glamour lining up in an existential contest against isolation, slackening limbs and lethargy. With unique access behind the scences, the Palace in Miami is shown as a buzzing and luzurious senior living community, repeatedly voted "American's Number One". The seniors live in a world full of parties and entertainment, but the Palace is also a thrivin business.... Who said that old age has to be boring? Golden Age opens the doors to the Palace, a retirement home of the kind that you have never seen before, in Miami. Gildings, ostentatious chandeliers, marble floors; like a cross between a luxury hotel and an Americanised copy of Versailles, the place is presented by its developers as the most beautiful retirement home in the US. The residents here are pampered by an army of employees devoted to their every whim, in a oermanent party atmosphere. This abundance of luxury, extravagance and entertainment is nonetheless not enough to remove the anxieties of those who live there. Nor can it hide the intention of the investors for whome old age is above all source of income and a growing market. Golden Age takes us on a journey into this baroque universe which tries to suppress the fear of death through dollars, questioning, in a dizzying visual whirlwind, our relationship to old age in its most universal aspect.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Rangers are an elite light infantry whose sole purpose is to seek out and destroy the enemy. Each year, the US Army Ranger School holds a competition. A competition to find the best Ranger team in the army. Considered by many to be the ultimate Army Olympics, this intense 3 day event test the best soldiers in the world, to see who is the ultimate warrior

programme.title: The Illusion of Abundance
programme.desc: Three women share a common goal: Carolina, Bertha and Maxima are leading today's fight against modern conquistadors. Whereas governments and corporations, trapped in a global race towards unlimited growth, need to get the cheapest raw materials, these three women tell us a story of tireless courage: how to keep fighting to protect nature when your life is at risk?

programme.title: State of Rodeo
programme.desc: State of Rodeo follows a diverse group of characters who participate in the sport of rodeo and explores the heritage of the cattle industry within the state of Florida and it's influence on western culture from the time of Ponce De Leon's first settlement to present day cowboys and cowgirls. Rodeo still fascinates to this day, the heritage of this sport's tradition is one of the founding industries of our nation and most people don't know that Florida played an integral role in this history.

programme.title: The Song That Calls You Home
programme.desc: Filmmakers Vanni Mangoni and Luis Robledo explore the practices of Amazonian folk healers or medicine men who use herbs, hallucinogenic plants, magic, and spiritualism to treat illnesses.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Bullets, shrapnel, and IEDs, all are dangers for Infantry. Modern military forces have designed a new generation of armor to help protect soldiers from the dangers of battle – Infantry Fighting Vehicles. This fascinating episode examines the progress of technology since the Second World War that has led to some of the incredibly versatile and lethal weapon systems known as Infantry Fighting Vehicles.

programme.title: The River Between Us
programme.desc: A River Between Us tells the story of the oldest and most bitterly disputed water war in the West today. The film's primary focus is the struggle for justice on the Klamath River, where forty years of bad blood between the local farmers, ranchers, Native Tribes, members of the Tea Party, state politicians and federal government have created one of this country's worst environmental crises. Most importantly, as part of the largest restoration project in American history, A River Between Us provides the solution to ending this generations-old conflict: in order to save a river, you must first heal a people.

programme.title: A Gallery Without Walls
programme.desc: In a secluded spot at the eastern end of New Zealand's Waiheke Island lies Connells Bay where John and Jo Gow, passionate and well-known in art and sculpture circles have established the Connells Bay Sculpture Park where art and nature are united to create special spaces for site specific sculpture.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Noth this one.

programme.title: The War You Don't See
programme.desc: The War You Don't See is a powerful and timely investigation into the media's role in war, tracing the history of 'embedded' ad independent reporting from the carnage of World War One to the destruction of Hiroshima, and from the invasion of Vietnam to the current war in Afghanistan and disaster in Iraq. As weapons and propaganda become even more sophisticated, the nature of war is developing into an 'electronic battlefield' in which journalists play a key role, and civilians are the victims. But who is the real enemy?

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Air-to-air combat is one the principle war fighting skills a new pilot must learn. At a massive international air exercise we join crews from several countries as they learn the basics of air combat and what it takes to survive. We also learn about the technology of modern fighter jets.

programme.title: Apollo 8 Christmas At The Moon
programme.desc: This one hour documentary profiles the first manned Mission to the Moon, and includes interviews with the astronauts and many of the NASA officials who were a part of this historic event.

programme.title: Meltdown in Dixie
programme.desc: In the wake of the 2015 Charleston Massacre, a battle erupts in Orangeburg, South Carolina between the Sons of Confederate Veterans and an ice cream shop owner forced to fly the Confederate flag in his parking lot. MELTDOWN IN DIXIE explores the broader role of Confederate symbolism in 21st century America and the lingering racial oppression which these symbols help maintain.

programme.title: Last House Standing
programme.desc: It is about the stories about people who lost everything in natural disasters. Every year people lost their homes and many rebuild the exact same way. Most people had no idea if their insurance will actually get them whole again after a major disaster. If they have to evacuate, and their house is destroyed, many of the things that were lost can never be replaced. When you watch The Last House Stanidng you will meet people who are living the nightmare, and it doesn't have to be this way.

programme.title: On The Inside Of a Military Dictatorship
programme.desc:
“On the Inside of a Military Dictatorship” takes its audience back to when the military made their master plan for a so-called disciplined democracy in Myanmar and wrote a very scripted role for their enemy no. 1; Aung San Suu Kyi. In a dramatic way, the film builds the character- and story set-up to take us anew into the crisis we know from the news – however, with a radically different perspective. The story is based on unique acces to the key players in this complicated reality, including Aung San Suu Kyi and previous President Thein Sein.
It’s the story of how power struggles unfold and how political enemies can end up being closer than the ones they claim to fight for: the people. The audience gets deeper and deeper into this complex world of power driven by peculiar characters and even astrology.

programme.desc: In the wake of the 2015 Charleston Massacre, a battle erupts in Orangeburg, South Carolina between the Sons of Confederate Veterans and an ice cream shop owner forced to fly the Confederate flag in his parking lot. MELTDOWN IN DIXIE explores the broader role of Confederate symbolism in 21st century America and the lingering racial oppression which these symbols help maintain.

programme.title: Last House Standing
programme.desc: It is about the stories about people who lost everything in natural disasters. Every year people lost their homes and many rebuild the exact same way. Most people had no idea if their insurance will actually get them whole again after a major disaster. If they have to evacuate, and their house is destroyed, many of the things that were lost can never be replaced. When you watch The Last House Stanidng you will meet people who are living the nightmare, and it doesn't have to be this way.

programme.title: On The Inside Of a Military Dictatorship
programme.desc:
“On the Inside of a Military Dictatorship” takes its audience back to when the military made their master plan for a so-called disciplined democracy in Myanmar and wrote a very scripted role for their enemy no. 1; Aung San Suu Kyi. In a dramatic way, the film builds the character- and story set-up to take us anew into the crisis we know from the news – however, with a radically different perspective. The story is based on unique acces to the key players in this complicated reality, including Aung San Suu Kyi and previous President Thein Sein.
It’s the story of how power struggles unfold and how political enemies can end up being closer than the ones they claim to fight for: the people. The audience gets deeper and deeper into this complex world of power driven by peculiar characters and even astrology.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Airborne soldiers are known as force multipliers because of their unique capabilities. Dropped behind enemy lines they can secure bridges or conduct ambushes. We learn more about what it takes to be a paratrooper at two of the best airborne schools in the world.

programme.title: Blame Game
programme.desc: Blame Game explores the challenges but also the possible solutions - some very simple - that could reduce waste, take advantage of an impressive skill-set, alleviate poverty and help our environment.

programme.title: The Last Surviving Cheetah's
programme.desc: Centered around the Asiatic Cheetah, an endangered species, which was believed to have been extinct before 1996. 'The Last Surviving Cheetahs" us a retracing of the director's journey to discover the Asiatic cheetahs in remote regions of Iran, and features footage gathered over 20 years of documenting and recording this animal.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Noth this one.

programme.title: Our Story - Tales of Intensive Care
programme.desc: This landmark documentary by Oscar-winning director Kevin Macdonald, tells the story of Covid-19 virus in Britain through the experiences of people immersed in its impact, both personally and professionally. Using testimony from consultants, doctors and nurses - as well as weaving in the experience of patients, this documentary paints a vivid portrait of the working lives of ICU staff and those they treat during a global pandemic which proves both challenging, life-changing and often tragic for those caught in it.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: In the field of honor there is one group that stands above the rest, combat medics. They are there to help aid the wounded soldier, even if it is under heavy fire. We travel to several medic schools and participate in their training exercises to learn what it takes to save lives and make a difference for their comrades.

programme.title: Undaunted, Chasing History at the Boston Marathon
programme.desc: "Undaunted: Chasing History at the Boston Marathon" is a film about the comeback of one unique runner, a 3-foot-9 physician assistant who has been mistaken for a runaway child while training. It's also about a city rallying against terror. Thousands of runners returned to compete, while a million spectators came back to cheer despite their fear. Many more around the world admired a city that wouldn't be intimidated by an attack that left hundreds wounded and three dead. "Undaunted" is also a film about every runner's fantasy: For the first half of the 2014 race, to the astonishment and sustained applause of thousands along the course, Juli led the pack.

programme.title: Jaffa: A Guide to Gentrification
programme.desc: Jaffa, once a major port in the Middle East and the sister city of Tel Aviv, “the most expensive city in the world” per The Economist, has grown into an international tourist center, a coveted destination and last but not least a true real estate gem.

programme.title: Idomeni
programme.desc: Idomeni is both a place suspended in time, and a film shaped by scenes from the parallel lives of adults and children in the camp. The children do not go to school but live in their own world and take care of each other, having little contact with their surroundings. The film catches their bubble and shows: they are tomorrow's Europe. It is a place where you are suspended in time. You cannot move forward and you cannot go back. You are confined. But it is not a prison, it is a refugee camp. Refugee camps are usually located far away from the rest of society and they become like worlds of their own. This is a film about life in the camps. The film does not explore the dramatic events of the journey but the seemingly still and slowed down moments in the camps.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Every soldier, sailor and airmen has to pass one hurdle before coming a member of the military – basic training. This episode examines the physical and psychological tests and training that occur in basic training. The training that takes civilians and molds them into the warriors of the future!

programme.title: War Peace
programme.desc: War/Peace documentary film is re-introducing the radical student activists from the late 60s. Ex-leaders of The Weather Underground movement Bill Ayers and Bernardine Dohrn. For decades the government and press have tried their best to silence them. This film will serve as an historical reminder of what happened the last time a group of young minds planned to take over an unpopular government in Washington.

programme.title: Lalgam
programme.desc: Documentary that denounces the damage caused by the use of land mines in Western Sahara and shows the lives of those affected.

programme.title: Breaking the Silence - Victims of Abuse
programme.desc: Breaking the Silence is a call to action that illuminates the voices of survivors of childhood abuse and sexual trauma. Through powerful interviews, it reveals the impact of systemic neglect-and the path to healing, recovery, and collective awareness.

programme.title: A Social Cure
programme.desc: The true story of the highly successful South African social media campaign to combat AIDS

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Combat requires that soldiers be tough, capable of strength and good cardio-vascular endurance. Combat fitness is the specialized training that is given to soldiers to help them survive. We learn why this is important and how this training is even adapted for civilians.

programme.title: Golden Age
programme.desc: Extravaganza and glamour lining up in an existential contest against isolation, slackening limbs and lethargy. With unique access behind the scences, the Palace in Miami is shown as a buzzing and luzurious senior living community, repeatedly voted "American's Number One". The seniors live in a world full of parties and entertainment, but the Palace is also a thrivin business.... Who said that old age has to be boring? Golden Age opens the doors to the Palace, a retirement home of the kind that you have never seen before, in Miami. Gildings, ostentatious chandeliers, marble floors; like a cross between a luxury hotel and an Americanised copy of Versailles, the place is presented by its developers as the most beautiful retirement home in the US. The residents here are pampered by an army of employees devoted to their every whim, in a oermanent party atmosphere. This abundance of luxury, extravagance and entertainment is nonetheless not enough to remove the anxieties of those who live there. Nor can it hide the intention of the investors for whome old age is above all source of income and a growing market. Golden Age takes us on a journey into this baroque universe which tries to suppress the fear of death through dollars, questioning, in a dizzying visual whirlwind, our relationship to old age in its most universal aspect.

programme.title: Slow Fashion
programme.desc: Slow Fashion is a documentary that explores cultural appropriation of indigenous designs in Mexico by an international fashion designer and the way weavers and block printers in Laos and India are working with new sustainable designers, whose principals and practices are based on equality, not hierarchy. A major fashion designer from Paris has been appropriating traditional designs in the community of Tlahuitoltepec in the highlands of Oaxaca, Mexico. In response to this and other instances of global appropriation, Mexico's Ministry of Culture has asked global fashion brands for “a public explanation on what basis it could privatize collective property". Can credit and compensation be given to indigenous communities where the designs come from? Given the vast economic disparity between local communities of origin and the global companies, who are appropriating their designs; it becomes a matter of not only collective property rights, but also human and cultural rights. In Laos, craftmanship and the value of culture is examined by Nanci Takayama, professor/sustainable fashion activist. Working with communities of Laotian weavers, she raises the subject of empowerment of women artisans and weavers and explores alternative socially conscious ways of working with them in collaboration. programme.title: I'm In Love With My Car
programme.desc: A colorful, sparkling history of The Car and us, in it. Hearing, smell, touch, sight, taste, that is to say all of the human biological nature, has apparently changed since we started driving. More than any other object, cars are anthropologically modified human beings, changed our world's perception and our way of engaging with it. With our unconditional love for cars at a turning point, will it survive?

programme.title: Women Behind The Wheel
programme.desc:
Two women. One epic journey. Countless stories that deserve to be heard. Cat and Hannah undertake a road trip across Central Asia on a mission to uncover women's stories in a region miles from their own. But along the journey, they're forced to challenge the assumptions they set out with.
Writers

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Combat requires that soldiers be tough, capable of strength and good cardio-vascular endurance. Combat fitness is the specialized training that is given to soldiers to help them survive. We learn why this is important and how this training is even adapted for civilians.

programme.title: Golden Age
programme.desc: Extravaganza and glamour lining up in an existential contest against isolation, slackening limbs and lethargy. With unique access behind the scences, the Palace in Miami is shown as a buzzing and luzurious senior living community, repeatedly voted "American's Number One". The seniors live in a world full of parties and entertainment, but the Palace is also a thrivin business.... Who said that old age has to be boring? Golden Age opens the doors to the Palace, a retirement home of the kind that you have never seen before, in Miami. Gildings, ostentatious chandeliers, marble floors; like a cross between a luxury hotel and an Americanised copy of Versailles, the place is presented by its developers as the most beautiful retirement home in the US. The residents here are pampered by an army of employees devoted to their every whim, in a oermanent party atmosphere. This abundance of luxury, extravagance and entertainment is nonetheless not enough to remove the anxieties of those who live there. Nor can it hide the intention of the investors for whome old age is above all source of income and a growing market. Golden Age takes us on a journey into this baroque universe which tries to suppress the fear of death through dollars, questioning, in a dizzying visual whirlwind, our relationship to old age in its most universal aspect.

programme.title: Slow Fashion
programme.desc: Slow Fashion is a documentary that explores cultural appropriation of indigenous designs in Mexico by an international fashion designer and the way weavers and block printers in Laos and India are working with new sustainable designers, whose principals and practices are based on equality, not hierarchy. A major fashion designer from Paris has been appropriating traditional designs in the community of Tlahuitoltepec in the highlands of Oaxaca, Mexico. In response to this and other instances of global appropriation, Mexico's Ministry of Culture has asked global fashion brands for “a public explanation on what basis it could privatize collective property". Can credit and compensation be given to indigenous communities where the designs come from? Given the vast economic disparity between local communities of origin and the global companies, who are appropriating their designs; it becomes a matter of not only collective property rights, but also human and cultural rights. In Laos, craftmanship and the value of culture is examined by Nanci Takayama, professor/sustainable fashion activist. Working with communities of Laotian weavers, she raises the subject of empowerment of women artisans and weavers and explores alternative socially conscious ways of working with them in collaboration. programme.title: I'm In Love With My Car
programme.desc: A colorful, sparkling history of The Car and us, in it. Hearing, smell, touch, sight, taste, that is to say all of the human biological nature, has apparently changed since we started driving. More than any other object, cars are anthropologically modified human beings, changed our world's perception and our way of engaging with it. With our unconditional love for cars at a turning point, will it survive?

programme.title: The Illusion of Abundance
programme.desc: Three women share a common goal: Carolina, Bertha and Maxima are leading today's fight against modern conquistadors. Whereas governments and corporations, trapped in a global race towards unlimited growth, need to get the cheapest raw materials, these three women tell us a story of tireless courage: how to keep fighting to protect nature when your life is at risk?

programme.title: State of Rodeo
programme.desc: State of Rodeo follows a diverse group of characters who participate in the sport of rodeo and explores the heritage of the cattle industry within the state of Florida and it's influence on western culture from the time of Ponce De Leon's first settlement to present day cowboys and cowgirls. Rodeo still fascinates to this day, the heritage of this sport's tradition is one of the founding industries of our nation and most people don't know that Florida played an integral role in this history.

Destination
programme.desc: Doused in heritage with old hamlets, drowsy villages and towns studding its lush green hills, Southern France’s Occitania region only officially come into being in 2016 with the pairing of Languedoc-Roussillon and the Midi-Pyrenees. The two historically Occitan regions are blessed with colour, tranquility, and a wealth of UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Food and drink are still approached with reverence in the region, and a whistle stop tour around four different departments of the Midi Pyrenees; Tarn, Gers, Tarn-et-Garonne and Haute Garonne gives you plenty of opportunity to experience some of its best gastronomy, as Katy Dartford discovers.

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc:
Samira is all excited for the Tandoori Party.
The world loves to BBQ and India has some of the oldest forms – Tandoori cooking. Samira takes a fresh approach to Tandoori cuisine and the grill that goes back thousands of years.
The Episode starts off with a visit to a Street Tandoori hub that makes Kababs that have a cult following of their own. Samira ends up taking over grill, learns the art of Tandoori breads and how can any Tandoori feast be complete without the Pièce de résistance, The Tandoori Chicken and a Party!

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: Join John Plaskett as he heads deep into the Pyrenees Mountains in Catalonia. Normally a popular destination during the winter months we thought we’d check it out during the summer. Experience the amazing views as John hikes through national parks and beautiful gorges. But it’s not just a place for trekking as he also experiences cycling on part of the Tour de France route and enjoys the thrills of white-water rafting.

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries.
Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets.
This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: The resort of Somabay, on Egypt’s Red Sea coast, may have only been around for a few years, but it’s already making a big impression. With a choice of top-class hotel, a championship golf course, and one of the biggest spa facilities in the whole of Africa, this is the ultimate getaway destination. There is also a vast private kite-surfing beach, diving and snorkelling facilities, and seemingly endless sandy beaches lapped by the warm waters of the Red Sea. No wonder presenter Trevor Claringbold describes it as one of his favourite destinations!

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off.
New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

Starting inland she explores some of the remains of ancient civilisations and experiences some incredible views of Alacati and the surrounding areas. After a brief stop off for some exquisite wine, she heads to the nearby coastal town of Cesme for some further exploring and puts herself to the test by having a go at the famous local sport of Wind Surfing.

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries.
Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets.
This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: Doused in heritage with old hamlets, drowsy villages and towns studding its lush green hills, Southern France’s Occitania region only officially come into being in 2016 with the pairing of Languedoc-Roussillon and the Midi-Pyrenees. The two historically Occitan regions are blessed with colour, tranquility, and a wealth of UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Food and drink are still approached with reverence in the region, and a whistle stop tour around four different departments of the Midi Pyrenees; Tarn, Gers, Tarn-et-Garonne and Haute Garonne gives you plenty of opportunity to experience some of its best gastronomy, as Katy Dartford discovers.

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc:
Samira is all excited for the Tandoori Party.
The world loves to BBQ and India has some of the oldest forms – Tandoori cooking. Samira takes a fresh approach to Tandoori cuisine and the grill that goes back thousands of years.
The Episode starts off with a visit to a Street Tandoori hub that makes Kababs that have a cult following of their own. Samira ends up taking over grill, learns the art of Tandoori breads and how can any Tandoori feast be complete without the Pièce de résistance, The Tandoori Chicken and a Party!

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: Doused in heritage with old hamlets, drowsy villages and towns studding its lush green hills, Southern France’s Occitania region only officially come into being in 2016 with the pairing of Languedoc-Roussillon and the Midi-Pyrenees. The two historically Occitan regions are blessed with colour, tranquility, and a wealth of UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Food and drink are still approached with reverence in the region, and a whistle stop tour around four different departments of the Midi Pyrenees; Tarn, Gers, Tarn-et-Garonne and Haute Garonne gives you plenty of opportunity to experience some of its best gastronomy, as Katy Dartford discovers.

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries.
Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets.
This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: The resort of Somabay, on Egypt’s Red Sea coast, may have only been around for a few years, but it’s already making a big impression. With a choice of top-class hotel, a championship golf course, and one of the biggest spa facilities in the whole of Africa, this is the ultimate getaway destination. There is also a vast private kite-surfing beach, diving and snorkelling facilities, and seemingly endless sandy beaches lapped by the warm waters of the Red Sea. No wonder presenter Trevor Claringbold describes it as one of his favourite destinations!

Analiza la erupción del Eyjafjallajökull en Islandia, los terremotos de Nepal. epidemias como el ébola y el SARS, el incendio de la Zona de Nuevo Desarrollo de Binhai en China, el huracán Sandy en Nueva York, el tsunami del Océano Índico en el sudeste asiático, un destructivo sumidero en Bosnia, el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima, la catástrofe del gas de Bhopal, el accidente del Exxon Valdez en Alaska, y accidentes de tráfico y aéreos.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle dan Putera Harry berkongsi minat yang serupa dan nampak seperti pasangan yang sempurna. Keduanya telah menghadapi masa sukar semasa membesar tetapi telah berjaya. Kini mereka sedang berjaya bersama. Istimewa sejam ini, yang menampilkan perbualan dengan penulis Andrew Morton, meneroka latar sosial yang menjadikan perkahwinan beraninya sesuai dengan Keluarga Diraja Britain hari ini.
programme.sub-title: Harry & Meghan: A Very Modern Romance

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E09 - Man and Man Eaters
programme.desc: Ivan Carter descubre la verdad sobre lo que ocurre cuando leones y humanos conviven en África.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E07 - Surf's Up
programme.desc: Un par de surfistas han recurrido a Island Air para vivir la aventura de su vida.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E07 - Surf's Up

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E08 - Closing Time
programme.desc: Una inesperada tormenta deja a Island Air luchando por retirar sus aviones para el mantenimiento obligatorio.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E08 - Closing Time

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E01 - Operation Caviar
programme.desc: 第7區的執法者在黃石河的進口釣魚區聚集，正值每年的槳魚遷徙。查看釣魚者嘗試捕捉槳魚以及執法者捕捉違規者的情況！

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E02 - Operation Camper
programme.desc: 位於蒙大拿州中南部的舌河水庫州立公園，夏季是喜歡娛樂和釣魚的人士的熱點。看守員邁克·克林斯忙於確保每個人都和睦相處，尤其是在夜幕降臨時。

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E01 - After the Fall
programme.desc: El escalador Craig DeMartino se precipita 30 metros por un acantilado de granito. Convertido en un montón de huesos rotos, Craig se aferra a la vida. En una fracción de segundo, la vida de Craig se convierte en una inspiradora lucha por sobrevivir.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S02:E01 - After the Fall

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E02 - A River's Grasp
programme.desc: En un aislado río de montaña, el pescador Dean Ririe queda irremediablemente atrapado bajo una roca con el agua hasta el cuello. En aguas heladas que deberían matar a un hombre, Dean lucha por su vida a kilómetros de la ayuda.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S02:E02 - A River's Grasp

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E02 - Omilak Silver Mine

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E03 - Operation Yellowstone

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E04 - Operation Antelope Dummy
programme.desc: 隨著普朗霍恩羚羊的數量下降，第7區的守護者在賽季開始前設置了一個誘餌突襲，但主要問題似乎是在開幕日進入的事故。而同時，第4區的守護者布萊恩·戈利接到了關於可能的偷獵事件的電話。

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E03 - ATV Nightmare
programme.desc: Una acampada de padre e hijo se convierte en una lucha desesperada por sobrevivir cuando John Sloot queda aplastado bajo un quad. Ahora su hijo de 10 años, Cody, debe enfrentarse solo a la naturaleza para conseguir ayuda.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S02:E03 - ATV Nightmare

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E04 - Trapped in a Glacier
programme.desc: Mientras practica senderismo en solitario en las profundidades del Parque Nacional de los Glaciares, Ted Porter se precipita por una grieta glaciar. Con la espalda rota y a kilómetros de cualquier persona, debe luchar para sobrevivir.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S02:E04 - Trapped in a Glacier

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E04 - Virtual Gold

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E05 - Prospectors

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E11 - Most Poisonous
programme.desc: You wouldn’t want to be bitten by any of these but which one has the deadliest poison? The venom from the most poisonous snake on the planet? A rare poisonous lizard? Or is it the blue ringed octopus?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E12 - Migration
programme.desc: Los animales, grandes y no tan grandes, recorren cientos de kilómetros, algunos en busca de comida, otros para encontrar el lugar ideal para reproducirse. Desde las cebras que atraviesan las sabanas africanas hasta los enormes viajes que emprenden las tortugas para encontrar la playa perfecta donde desovar, los viajes anuales, a menudo peligrosos, son simplemente alucinantes.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E13 - Who is the King?
programme.desc: Se calcula que hay aproximadamente 8,7 millones de especies diferentes de animales en la Tierra. Cada una de ellas ha desarrollado técnicas y habilidades de supervivencia únicas, específicas y a menudo mortales. ¿Cómo elegir un favorito entre un abanico tan amplio de criaturas espectaculares y hermosas?
programme.sub-title: Wild Ones - S01:E13 - Who is the King?

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E01 - British Colombia Moose
programme.desc: Conoce a Laramy Sasquatch Miller, uno de los últimos hombres de montaña de las Montañas Rocosas. Laramy Sasquatch Miller, de ascendencia india y entrenado por auténticos montañeses, sólo utiliza un arco hecho a mano y un rifle Hawken tradicional del calibre 54 para recorrer la ruta de los montañeses. Desde las profundidades de las Rocosas canadienses hasta las llanuras del Medio Oeste, cazando, cazando con trampas y sobreviviendo de la tierra.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E01 - British Colombia Moose

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E12 - Naturally Vibrant
programme.desc: El sur de Moravia, en la República Checa, alberga una gran variedad de hermosas orquídeas. Desde allí nos dirigimos al Caribe, a Cuba, con sus vistas de increíble belleza contrastadas con brutales peleas de gallos. De Cuba viajamos a Fiyi, en el Océano Pacífico, a menudo considerado un verdadero paraíso en la Tierra.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E12 - Naturally Vibrant

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E13 - Naturally Hewn
programme.desc: En este episodio viajamos del Sur al Norte de Tierra Santa, Israel, deteniéndonos para admirar las vistas y empaparnos de la importancia bíblica de los lugares históricos. Continuamos hacia los Altos del Golán, en el Norte, donde el conflicto reciente sigue siendo muy evidente, y concluimos nuestra peregrinación en las orillas de Galilea.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E13 - Naturally Hewn

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E01 - Naturally Wild
programme.desc: Muchas islas se encuentran en el mar entre Gran Bretaña y Escandinavia. Todas estas islas habrían permanecido cubiertas de nieve y la vida no habría sido sostenible de no ser por la Corriente del Golfo. Las aguas cálidas que fluyen por el Océano Atlántico hasta Sudamérica explican el clima templado de las islas, su rica naturaleza y una historia que se remonta miles de años atrás. Así son las tres islas que vamos a visitar hoy en Milagros de la Naturaleza: Vesterålen, la Isla Justa y las Orcadas.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E01 - Naturally Wild

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble
programme.desc: Zimbabue era inicialmente Rodesia del Sur y se encuentra al sur de las cataratas Victoria, junto al río Zambeze. Zambia era inicialmente Rodesia del Norte y se encuentra en la otra orilla del río. Zimbabue es un país sin salida al mar situado en el sureste de África. Limita al sur con Sudáfrica. Según los arqueólogos, los primeros registros indican que los primeros asentamientos humanos en esta zona se remontan al siglo III.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble

De Cuba viajamos a Fiyi, en el Océano Pacífico, a menudo considerado un verdadero paraíso en la Tierra.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E12 - Naturally Vibrant

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E13 - Naturally Hewn
programme.desc: En este episodio viajamos del Sur al Norte de Tierra Santa, Israel, deteniéndonos para admirar las vistas y empaparnos de la importancia bíblica de los lugares históricos. Continuamos hacia los Altos del Golán, en el Norte, donde el conflicto reciente sigue siendo muy evidente, y concluimos nuestra peregrinación en las orillas de Galilea.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E13 - Naturally Hewn

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E01 - Naturally Wild
programme.desc: Muchas islas se encuentran en el mar entre Gran Bretaña y Escandinavia. Todas estas islas habrían permanecido cubiertas de nieve y la vida no habría sido sostenible de no ser por la Corriente del Golfo. Las aguas cálidas que fluyen por el Océano Atlántico hasta Sudamérica explican el clima templado de las islas, su rica naturaleza y una historia que se remonta miles de años atrás. Así son las tres islas que vamos a visitar hoy en Milagros de la Naturaleza: Vesterålen, la Isla Justa y las Orcadas.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E01 - Naturally Wild

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble
programme.desc: Zimbabue era inicialmente Rodesia del Sur y se encuentra al sur de las cataratas Victoria, junto al río Zambeze. Zambia era inicialmente Rodesia del Norte y se encuentra en la otra orilla del río. Zimbabue es un país sin salida al mar situado en el sureste de África. Limita al sur con Sudáfrica. Según los arqueólogos, los primeros registros indican que los primeros asentamientos humanos en esta zona se remontan al siglo III.
programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E06 - Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: Kyrgyzstan. Jim and Corey journey to the Tian Shan mountain range in search of high altitude mountain dwelling sheep and ibex.
programme.sub-title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E06 - Heaven's Gate

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E05 - The Clewiston Terror
programme.desc: Un enorme jabalí está aterrorizando a los trabajadores de una granja en Clewiston, Florida. Manny es llamado para llevar al cerdo ante la justicia.
programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S05:E05 - The Clewiston Terror

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E06 - Wild Boar Naples
programme.desc: Manny caza jabalíes con su lanza tridente.
programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S05:E06 - Wild Boar Naples

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E07 - Slaying the Port Labelle Monster
programme.desc: Manny se enreda con un cerdo monstruoso en los densos bosques de Port Labelle.
programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S05:E07 - Slaying the Port Labelle Monster

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E08 - Save a Watermelon Kill a Boar Part 1
programme.desc: Manny sigue la pista de un jabalí que asalta campos de sandías en el suroeste de Florida.
programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S05:E08 - Save a Watermelon Kill a Boar Part 1

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E11 - Most Poisonous
programme.desc: You wouldn’t want to be bitten by any of these but which one has the deadliest poison? The venom from the most poisonous snake on the planet? A rare poisonous lizard? Or is it the blue ringed octopus?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E12 - Migration
programme.desc: Los animales, grandes y no tan grandes, recorren cientos de kilómetros, algunos en busca de comida, otros para encontrar el lugar ideal para reproducirse. Desde las cebras que atraviesan las sabanas africanas hasta los enormes viajes que emprenden las tortugas para encontrar la playa perfecta donde desovar, los viajes anuales, a menudo peligrosos, son simplemente alucinantes.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E13 - Who is the King?
programme.desc: Se calcula que hay aproximadamente 8,7 millones de especies diferentes de animales en la Tierra. Cada una de ellas ha desarrollado técnicas y habilidades de supervivencia únicas, específicas y a menudo mortales. ¿Cómo elegir un favorito entre un abanico tan amplio de criaturas espectaculares y hermosas?
programme.sub-title: Wild Ones - S01:E13 - Who is the King?

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E01 - British Colombia Moose
programme.desc: Conoce a Laramy Sasquatch Miller, uno de los últimos hombres de montaña de las Montañas Rocosas. Laramy Sasquatch Miller, de ascendencia india y entrenado por auténticos montañeses, sólo utiliza un arco hecho a mano y un rifle Hawken tradicional del calibre 54 para recorrer la ruta de los montañeses. Desde las profundidades de las Rocosas canadienses hasta las llanuras del Medio Oeste, cazando, cazando con trampas y sobreviviendo de la tierra.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E01 - British Colombia Moose

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: 當戴安娜訂婚時，她始終處於媒體的視野中。她在一生中專注於自己的兒子，並致力於慈善工作，例如對地雷發表意見。戴安娜利用自己的名氣來引起人們對這些和其他重要問題的關注。這部經過深思熟慮的節目更深入地研究了20世紀最驚人的人物之一。通過前所未見的畫面，它展示了她從一個害羞的少女走到成為威爾士公主戴安娜的歷程，包括她最後日子的感人時刻。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E02 - The Heart of the Conflict
programme.desc: Investigando una serie de leones asesinados, Ivan llega al corazón mismo de un antiguo conflicto entre humanos y leones. El resultado pondrá a prueba los propios valores fundamentales de Ivan sobre la cultura
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E02 - The Heart of the Conflict

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S02:E05 - Hanging by a Thread
programme.desc: Los pilotos de Tanalian Aviation Joel y Josiah se ganan la vida transportando una máquina de nieve varada.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S02:E05 - Hanging by a Thread

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S02:E06 - Into The Deep
programme.desc: Los pilotos de bush tienen que utilizar todas sus habilidades -buceo, aparejo submarino y vuelo experto- para intentar salvar un ala de de Havilland Beaver en el fondo del lago 6 Mile.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S02:E06 - Into The Deep

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E07 - Operation Spotted Dog
programme.desc: Working to protect our treasured natural resources in some of the country's most secluded spots means there's never a boring day on the job.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E08 - Operation Boat Float
programme.desc: In the shade of the wild mountains, the Yellowstone River transforms into a colorful spectacle during the yearly boat float weekend. Armed with jet boats, the Wardens gear up for a wild time, looking out for the river and helping out the wacky rafters.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E07 - The Journal
programme.desc: El pastor Mike Turner está haciendo una excursión en solitario a través de la divisoria continental en la implacable cordillera Wind Rivers de Wyoming cuando queda irremediablemente atrapado bajo una roca. En su diario relata su agotadora lucha de 11 días por sobrevivir.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S02:E07 - The Journal

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E08 - Tree Stand Fall
programme.desc: El cazador de ciervos Nathan Holcomb cae en picado desde su puesto en el árbol. La peor pesadilla de cualquier cazador se convierte en la realidad de Nathan. Con la espalda rota y paralizado, Nathan debe arrastrarse por su cuenta para encontrar ayuda.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S02:E08 - Tree Stand Fall

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E01 - A Family Affair
programme.desc: En los remotos rincones de la sabana de Alaska hay recompensas sin igual. Áspera, cruda y ahora cocinada, ésta es la última frontera culinaria donde un chef está redefiniendo lo que significa comer como un salvaje. Los clientes quisquillosos, los cambios climáticos bipolares y la escasez de alimentos y suministros a menudo llevan a Bradley al límite de su cordura, pero este espíritu creativo y libre siempre cumple.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E03 - Deadman's Survival
programme.desc: Island Air lucha contra el tiempo y los elementos, para rescatar a un grupo atrapado en Deadman's Bay.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E03 - Deadman's Survival

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E06 - Training Day
programme.desc: Island Air es el salvavidas de muchos en Kodiak. A veces, las violentas condiciones meteorológicas impiden que los aviones aterricen, así que Erik aprovecha el día para enseñar a Pete a utilizar la escotilla de la cámara para practicar un poco el tiro al blanco.
programme.sub-title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E06 - Training Day

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E01 - Into the High Lonesome
programme.desc: Laramy Sasquatch Miller emprende El Camino con su fiel caballo 7, para poner a prueba sus habilidades de supervivencia y rendir homenaje a los hombres de montaña del pasado. Al despedirse de su familia, Laramy y 7 tienen que luchar contra los elementos, construir refugios, vivir de la tierra y sobrevivir a una travesía de 30 días por el interior del país.
programme.sub-title: The Trail - S01:E01 - Into the High Lonesome

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E05 - Surviving a Lightning Strike
programme.desc: Laura y Nick determinan el poder que tienen los rayos y cómo se comportan en un Laboratorio de Pruebas de Rayos de Efectos Directos de última generación. Ofrecen consejos a cazadores y pescadores para protegerse de ellos.
programme.sub-title: Survival Science - S01:E05 - Surviving a Lightning Strike

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E06 - ATV Accidents
programme.desc: Laura y Nick preparan unas espectaculares pruebas de ATV a alta velocidad para ver cómo se producen los accidentes y qué hacer para protegerse de los daños.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E07 - Treestand Accidents
programme.desc: Explorando por qué ocurren los accidentes de treestand y cómo prevenirlos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E08 - Surviving Nature's Fury
programme.desc: Nick Mundt y Laura Schara experimentan la furia de la Naturaleza a través de asombrosos equipos generadores de tormentas que simulan terribles huracanes, vientos helados e incluso tornados. Para estos experimentos utilizarán la extraordinaria tecnología que crea enormes tormentas en los platós de Hollywood.
programme.sub-title: Survival Science - S01:E08 - Surviving Nature's Fury

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E10 - Soul of a Survivor
programme.desc: Craig DeMartino examina las historias de otros supervivientes que ha conocido a lo largo de la temporada. Sus historias de supervivencia son todas diferentes, pero Craig descubre que estos supervivientes comparten más cosas en común de lo que se podría pensar.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S03:E10 - Soul of a Survivor

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E01 - Volcanoes
programme.desc: El mayor espectáculo del mundo es también el más feroz. Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los volcanes y examina las erupciones de Montserrat, que devastó media isla caribeña, la erupción de 1973 en la isla islandesa de Heimaey, la erupción de 2010 del Eyjafjallajökull, que bloqueó el tráfico aéreo en Europa, la erupción del Merapi en Indonesia y del monte Nyiragongo en el Congo, y el supervolcán de Yellowstone.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E02 - Earthquake
programme.desc: Cuando la Tierra se mueve de verdad, significa un desastre a escala épica. Horas desesperadas analiza la fuerza destructiva de los terremotos y se fija en el terremoto de Katmandú (Nepal) de 2015, el terremoto de Sichuan (China) de 2008, en el que se calcula que 10.000 niños quedaron atrapados en edificios escolares derrumbados, el terremoto de Puerto Mont (Chile) de 1960, el terremoto de Puerto Príncipe (Haití) de 2010 y el terremoto de Cachemira (Pakistán) de 2005.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E03 - Epidemic
programme.desc: Desperate Hours analiza grandes epidemias como el brote africano de ébola en Sudán, que acabó provocando casos en Estados Unidos e Inglaterra, el brote indio de viruela en Bihar, el brote africano de cólera, el brote de SARS en Guanghzhou (China) y la gripe aviar de Hong Kong.

Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los volcanes y examina las erupciones de Montserrat, que devastó media isla caribeña, la erupción de 1973 en la isla islandesa de Heimaey, la erupción de 2010 del Eyjafjallajökull, que bloqueó el tráfico aéreo en Europa, la erupción del Merapi en Indonesia y del monte Nyiragongo en el Congo, y el supervolcán de Yellowstone.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E02 - Earthquake
programme.desc: Cuando la Tierra se mueve de verdad, significa un desastre a escala épica. Horas desesperadas analiza la fuerza destructiva de los terremotos y se fija en el terremoto de Katmandú (Nepal) de 2015, el terremoto de Sichuan (China) de 2008, en el que se calcula que 10.000 niños quedaron atrapados en edificios escolares derrumbados, el terremoto de Puerto Mont (Chile) de 1960, el terremoto de Puerto Príncipe (Haití) de 2010 y el terremoto de Cachemira (Pakistán) de 2005.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E03 - Epidemic
programme.desc: Desperate Hours analiza grandes epidemias como el brote africano de ébola en Sudán, que acabó provocando casos en Estados Unidos e Inglaterra, el brote indio de viruela en Bihar, el brote africano de cólera, el brote de SARS en Guanghzhou (China) y la gripe aviar de Hong Kong.

programme.desc: Island Air es el salvavidas de muchos en Kodiak. A veces, las violentas condiciones meteorológicas impiden que los aviones aterricen, así que Erik aprovecha el día para enseñar a Pete a utilizar la escotilla de la cámara para practicar un poco el tiro al blanco.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E01 - Into the High Lonesome
programme.desc: Laramy Sasquatch Miller emprende El Camino con su fiel caballo 7, para poner a prueba sus habilidades de supervivencia y rendir homenaje a los hombres de montaña del pasado. Al despedirse de su familia, Laramy y 7 tienen que luchar contra los elementos, construir refugios, vivir de la tierra y sobrevivir a una travesía de 30 días por el interior del país.
programme.sub-title: The Trail - S01:E01 - Into the High Lonesome

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E05 - Surviving a Lightning Strike
programme.desc: Laura y Nick determinan el poder que tienen los rayos y cómo se comportan en un Laboratorio de Pruebas de Rayos de Efectos Directos de última generación. Ofrecen consejos a cazadores y pescadores para protegerse de ellos.
programme.sub-title: Survival Science - S01:E05 - Surviving a Lightning Strike

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E06 - ATV Accidents
programme.desc: Laura y Nick preparan unas espectaculares pruebas de ATV a alta velocidad para ver cómo se producen los accidentes y qué hacer para protegerse de los daños.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E07 - Treestand Accidents
programme.desc: Explorando por qué ocurren los accidentes de treestand y cómo prevenirlos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E08 - Surviving Nature's Fury
programme.desc: Nick Mundt y Laura Schara experimentan la furia de la Naturaleza a través de asombrosos equipos generadores de tormentas que simulan terribles huracanes, vientos helados e incluso tornados. Para estos experimentos utilizarán la extraordinaria tecnología que crea enormes tormentas en los platós de Hollywood.
programme.sub-title: Survival Science - S01:E08 - Surviving Nature's Fury
